info.name: Matomo Reporting API for plugin Visit Time API
info.description: VisitTime API lets you access reports by Hour (Server time), and by Hour Local Time of your visitors.

item.name: Visit time get visit information per local time

query.description: Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.
(Required) Website ID(s) to query. - Single site ID (e.g. 1) - Multiple site IDs (e.g. [1, 4, 5]) - Comma-separated list ("1,4,5") or "all"
(Required) The period to process, processes data for the period containing the specified date.
(Required) The date or date range to process. 'YYYY-MM-DD', magic keywords (today, yesterday, lastWeek, lastMonth, lastYear), or date range (ie, 'YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD', lastX, previousX).
Custom segment to filter the report. Example: "referrerName==example.com" Supports AND (;) and OR (,) operators.

request.description: Returns visit counts grouped by each visitor's local hour at the start of the visit.

response.name:
Visit counts grouped by each visitor's local hour.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

item.name: Visit time get by day of week

query.description: Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.
(Required) The numeric ID of the website to query. This endpoint does not support multiple sites.
(Required) The period to process, processes data for the period containing the specified date.

(Required) The date or date range to process. 'YYYY-MM-DD', magic keywords (today, yesterday, lastWeek, lastMonth, lastYear), or date range (ie, 'YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD', lastX, previousX). Multiple dates are not supported unless $period is 'range'.
Custom segment to filter the report. Example: "referrerName==example.com" Supports AND (;) and OR (,) operators.

request.description: Returns visit counts grouped by day of the week.

response.name:
Visit counts grouped into day-of-week rows for the requested period.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.
